_what: A reader's verdict on reconcile.py's matches, made after the counts existed and kept in a separate file for that reason. reconcile.py declares a normalisation that deletes spaces and hyphens before matching, which is the right default for a count that must not undercount and the wrong one for the question *is this word in the source*. Every match for the six terms in doubt was printed by inspect.py and read. Nothing here edits readings.json.
rule: A match counts as the term if the letters form that word in the source. It does not count if they are part of a longer word, or if they only appear because the extractor dropped a word gap.

special.note: the single hit is `especially` (R2004). The genus operator of this practice's sentence -- `a special case of` -- is not in either text.

onto.note: `contours` twice, and twice across a dropped word gap (`phenomenon to be`, `generalization to decide`). Not the preposition.

observer.note: `we can observe - roughly`, joined into `observeroughly` by the space deletion. The noun does not occur; the verb `observe` does, eleven times, always of the scientist looking.

norm.note: absent from both texts. `normal` occurs once in each, of cells and of bodily processes, never of a standard.

case.note: all genuine and all in the sense of an instance or an episode -- `case studies`, `in this case`, `in the second case`. None in the taxonomic sense `a special case of` needs.

already.note: all five are ordinary temporal adverbs in historical narration -- Darwin had already been interested, Drosophila had already conquered the laboratories. None does conceptual work, where this practice has given the word two fixed readings.

thing.note: two are `everything`; the rest are `epistemic things`, `those things`, `The Shape of Time. Remarks on the History of Things`.

difference.note: `difference`, `differences`, `differential`, `differentiation`, `differ`. The word is central in both texts.

summary.why_they_differ: Three matches survive the counter and not the reading: `especially`, `contours` and a word gap the extractor dropped. The declared looseness inflated presence by exactly three terms, in the direction it was declared to fail in.
